purpose: Draft questions for extras' three Buzz jobs. Not a live hook. Cutoffs are starting points to review, not proven. Copied into extras visitor kit from JEV-research.

state_shape.from: display name or pubkey prefix of the author

needs_chair.instructions: Does this Buzz wake need a house agent to act (reply, edit, or run a tool), rather than only to be read?

who.instructions: Which house chair should act on this wake, if any?

criteria.grok: Grok Build should research, write, or use tools.
criteria.codex: Codex should write or review code.
criteria.agy: Antigravity should scout or try a cheap pass.
criteria.ignore: No chair should act. Log or drop it.
criteria.other: None of these chairs fit. Do not guess.

public_ok.instructions: Is it okay to put this content on a public Buzz wall, rather than a private book or a DM to Prime?

prefilter: scripts/visitor/jev/prefilter.py — skip BUZZ_OK / VISITOR_WAKE / empty text before any HTTP call
compose_in_code: Run prefilter first. Skip Jev on watcher/control lines.
If needs_chair is between unsure_low and unsure_high inclusive: DM Prime. Do not pick a chair.
If needs_chair is below unsure_low: ignore. Do not wake a mouth.
If who.confidence is below who_min_confidence or who.choice is other: DM Prime.
If public_ok is below public_ok_yes: keep private. Never dump a recap on the public wall.
If the API call errors: stop. Do not let the action through.
